findings.title: Shipped skills recommend cross-entry schemas to customers whose installed @cipherstash/stack predates the fix
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The head skills now recommend cross-entry schemas, and the fallback only says 'upgrade' without naming a version, so customers whose separately versioned stash skills sit next to an older stack get TS2322 that agents may silence with casts.

findings.title: Types now assert one EncryptedV3Column while runtime has several copies, so a future instanceof check silently misclassifies wasm-authored tables
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The finding admits no instanceof check exists at head and runtime detection is structural and fails closed, so the harm depends on hypothetical future code.

findings.title: Re-chunked wasm-inline declarations fail to resolve or degrade to any for edge type-checkers
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The claim that shared chunks carry imports edge checkers cannot resolve is speculative (the author did not inspect the output), and the dist-types gates already compile dist/wasm-inline.d.ts in CI.
